Exact address questions · no address stored here

Need something that depends on your exact address?

School assignment, voting or ward information, property records and some permit or zoning questions can change block by block. Franklin Navigator does not need to save your exact address to help you reach the right official lookup.

School zone or district

Start with the Franklin school guide, then use the responsible district's official zoning or enrollment lookup for your address.

Open official school-zone lookups

Ward, voting or public representation

Use the civic guide to reach official ward, election and public-meeting sources without saving your home address in My Franklin.

Open ward and voting lookups

Property, tax or zoning

Separate assessor/property records from City zoning, permits and development questions, then use the responsible official lookup.

Open property and parcel lookups

Permit or home project

Address and project type can affect which permit, review or inspection applies. Prepare the project first, then confirm with the City.

Open zoning and City GIS lookups

Future address-aware automation requires a validated Franklin/Williamson GIS or official lookup integration and explicit consent. Franklin Navigator does not guess a school zone, ward, jurisdiction, zoning result or property status. Enter an address only on the responsible official lookup.

Keep one Franklin follow-up from getting lost.

Add a simple reminder such as “check school calendar,” “follow up on permit,” or “review my business listing.” Reminders stay only in this browser and do not send notifications when the browser is closed.
